answer: Commit-reveal verdicts bound to a future beacon resist score buying. (1) Each grader joins the lotus escrow, locking 1.00 unit and posting C = hash(score, salt) as the verdict anchor before grading opens. (2) When grading closes, a drand beacon publishes its next round; that plume of entropy selects 10% of verdicts for audit. (3) Graders reveal (score, salt); a mismatch or late reveal burns the escrow. An attacker running N sybils invests N units, slashing returns at most 0.6N, so verdict buying loses 40% per identity per epoch.
